**Representation of the Quantum Plane, its Quantum**

*Double and Harmonic Analysis on GL+*

92 pp, 34 sections.

**Abstract.** We give complete detail of the description of the GNS represe ntation of the quantum plane A and its dual ˆA as a von Neumann algebra. In particu- lar we obtain a rather surprising result that the multiplica tive unitary W is manageable in this quantum semigroup context. We study the q uantum dou- ble group construction introduced by Woronowicz, and using Baaj and Vaes’ construction of the multiplicative unitary Wm, we give the GNS description of the quantum double D(A) which is equivalent to GL+ q (2, R). Furthermore we study the fundamental corepresentation T λ,t and its matrix coeﬃcients, and show that it can be expressed by the b-hypergeometric function.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2 Preliminaries; 2.1 Mellin transform; 2.4 The multiplicative unitary; 2.5 q-commuting operators; 3 The quantum dilogarithm; 3.2 Integral transformations; 4 The quantum plane; 4.2 The quantum plane algebra and its modular ; 4.3 The Haar functional; 4.4 The GNS description; 4.5 Modular maps and the right picture; 4.6 The multiplicative unitary; 5 The dual space; 5.2 The non-degenerate pairing; 5.3 The GNS description; 5.4 The multiplicative unitary and modular map; 6 Transformation to new Hilbert spaces
